items.question: What were you doing before you started working here?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“What were you doing before you started working here?”，自然应答是“I was a real estate agent.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：B（I was a real estate agent.）。
